verses.text: Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús yet' heb' kreyente ay t'a yol yik Judea, ix yab' heb' to ay heb' manh israelok ix ak'anoch slolonel Dios t'a sk'ool.
Yuj chi' ayik ix k'ochxi winhaj Pedro t'a Jerusalén, ix yalan heb' kreyente israel to manh wach'ok ix yutej sb'a winh.
Ix yalan heb' icha tik t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj ix ach xit'ek' a k'umej heb' manh israelok, ach wa pax yet' heb'? xchi heb' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb' tastak ix uji chi', ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Ayinek' t'a chonhab' Jope. Haxo t'a jun k'u, wan in lesalwi, icha wayich ix aj wilan yemul jun niwan k'apak ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Yamb'il schikintak schanhil, ix emul b'aj ay in ek' chi'.
Ix in och k'elan t'ay yik swila' tas ayoch t'a yool. Haxo ix wilani, ay juntzanh nok' kaltakte'al nok' chanhe' yok. Ay nok' ay smay. Ay nok' chan yet' juntzanh nok' much.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wab'an yoch jun lolonel, ix yalani: Pedro, milcham juntzanh nok' tik a chi'a, xchi.
Palta ix in tak'wi t'ay: Maay, ach Wajal, yujto manta junelok tzin chi junok komon tas, ma junok tas ay yowalil yuj ley Moisés, xin chi t'ay.
Yuj chi', ix yalanemta junelxo t'ayin t'a satcha'anh: Ha juntzanh tas syal Dios to malaj yowalil, a hachxo tik, manh ala' to ay yowalil, xchi.
Oxel ix yal juntzanh chi' icha chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jixik'e jun k'apak chi' t'a satcha'anh.
Junanto rato chi' ix k'och oxwanh heb' winh t'a jun pat b'aj ayinek' chi'. Ha heb' winh chi', ha t'a chonhab' Cesarea ix chekjikot heb' winh, yik sb'at in sayan heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope.

Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, manh chab'k'olalok tzach b'at yet' heb' winh, xchi. Ix b'at pax wakwanhxo heb' winh kuk'tak tik wet'ok. Haxo ix onh k'och ta', ix onh och t'a yol spat jun winh.

Ix yalan winh t'ayonh to ix yil jun ángel winh, linhanek' t'a yol spat winh chi'. Ix yalan t'a winh: Chekb'at jaywanhok heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope, b'at yik'okab'kot winhaj Simón heb' winh, skuchan pax Pedro.
Ha winh ol halan t'ayach tas ol aj a kolchaji yet' jantaknhej heb' ayek' t'a yol a pat, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a winh.
Haxo yik ix in och ijan walan t'a heb', t'a jun rato chi' ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a heb', icha ix aj yoch t'ayonh t'a sb'ab'elal.

Yuj chi' ix in naankot tas alb'ilkan yuj Kajal Jesús, ayik ix yalan icha tik: Yel toni, a winhaj Juan ix ak'an bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha'. Palta a ex tik, ol ex ak'jok bautizar yuj Yespíritu Dios, xchi.

Ha Dios ix ak'an Yespíritu t'a heb' icha ix yutej yak'an t'ayonh ayik ix kak'anoch Kajal Jesucristo t'a ko k'ool. Yuj chi', ¿tom a in tik, syal in kachanoch waan tas sk'ulej Dios? xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.

Haxo heb' kreyente t'a Jerusalén chi', ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', manhxalaj tas ix yal heb'. Haxonhej wach' lolonel ix yal heb' t'a Dios. Ix yalan heb': --Hanhejtona' pax heb' manh israelok, ha Dios ix ak'an sna sb'a heb' yik wach' scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej ket'ok, xchi heb'.

Ayik ix miljicham winhaj Esteban, ix ak'jipax och syaelal heb' kreyente smasanil. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' elelal. Ay heb' ix k'och masanto t'a chonhab' Fenicia, t'a Chipre yet' t'a Antioquía. Ix laj yalanel wach' ab'ix heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal ayek' ta'. Palta malaj tas ix yal heb' t'a heb' manh israelok.
Palta ay jaywanh heb' kreyente aj Chipre yet' heb' aj Cirene ix k'och t'a chonhab' Antioquía chi'. Hata' ix yalel yab'ixal Jesucristo heb' t'a heb' manh israelok.
Haxo Jesús Kajal ix och yet' heb' kreyente chi', yuj chi' tzijtum anima ix sk'ex sb'eyb'al. Ix yak'anoch Kajal Jesús heb' t'a sk'ool.
Haxo heb' kreyente aj Jerusalén, ayik ix yab'an spekal jun chi' heb', ix schekb'at winhaj Bernabé heb' t'a Antioquía chi'.

Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yilan winh, te niwan swach'k'olal Dios ix yak' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix te tzalaj winh yuj heb'. Ix ak'ji stek'anil heb' yuj winh. Ix yalan winh to tek'an syutej sb'a heb', syak'anpax och spensar heb' t'a Kajal Jesús t'a masanil tiempo.

Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Bernabé chi' yalan t'a heb', yujto te wach' spensar winh. Te ayoch Espíritu Santo yet' winh. Syak' wal och Dios winh t'a sk'ool. Yuj chi' tzijtum wal heb' aj chonhab' chi' ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'ool yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a chonhab' Tarso, ix b'at sayanek' winhaj Saulo winh ta'. Haxo ix ilchaj winh yuj winh, ix yik'ankot winh winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía chi'.
Haxo ta' ix ek' jun ab'il heb' winh t'a skal heb' kreyente chi'. Tzijtum mach ix sk'ayb'ej heb' winh. Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', hata' ix ak'ji skuch heb' kreyente kristiano t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jaywanh heb' winh schekab' Dios ix b'at alanel slolonel. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, ix jawi heb' winh t'a Antioquía chi'.

Ay jun winh yetb'eyum heb' winh skuch Agabo. Ix k'e waan winh t'a skal heb' kreyente. Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an yal winh icha tik: --Ay jun niwan wejel ol jawok t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi winh. (Ha jun wejel ix yal winh chi', ha t'a stiempoal ayoch winhaj Claudio yajalil, hata' ix yak'a').
Yuj tas ix yal winhaj Agabo chi', haxo heb' kreyente aj Antioquía chi', ix el t'a sk'ool heb' to skolwaj heb' t'a heb' kreyente aj Judea, hato syala' jantak stzak'wan heb' yak'ani.
Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb'. Ix yak'anb'at yofrenda heb' t'a heb' winh ankiano aj Judea chi'. Haxo winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo ix ik'anb'at jun ofrenda chi'.
